suppliers.label: NVIDIA
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Mgmt: OpenAI+Anthropic ~15-20% of FY26 data center revenue; one direct customer hit 16% of total revenue in Q2 FY27 (10-Q).

suppliers.label: AMD
suppliers.disclosed_mix: No 10%+ customer in FY24/25 10-K, but mgmt: OpenAI ~43% of combined compute capacity across AMD's 3 core AI customers; Goldman ests OpenAI >40% of revenue by 2027.

suppliers.label: Intel
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Foundry still customer-light; CEO says a couple of external customers now engaging on 18A, with volume commitments expected H2 2026.

suppliers.label: TSMC
suppliers.disclosed_mix: HPC platform (AI/datacenter) = 68% of revenue in Q3 2026, up from 61% in Q1; TSMC doesn't disclose revenue by individual customer (Nvidia est. 22-25%, analyst est. not company-disclosed).

customers.name: AMD
customers.deal: N3/N2 wafers for Instinct MI series

customers.name: AVGO
customers.deal: N3P wafers for custom AI ASICs (TPU etc)

customers.name: 2454.TW
customers.deal: N3P wafers for TPU v7 'Ironwood' ASIC

suppliers.label: Broadcom
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Distributor customer = 42% of net revenue; top 5 end customers ~45% of net revenue (Q2 FY26 10-Q) across ~6 named AI ASIC customers, 2 undisclosed.

suppliers.label: Marvell
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Data center = ~79% of total revenue in FY26; 2 customers >=10% of revenue, top 10 customers = 82% of net revenue (FY26 10-K).

suppliers.label: MediaTek
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Mgmt guides AI ASIC revenue to ~$1B in 2026, scaling to 'several billion dollars' in 2027 (earnings call); shifting R&D priority from smartphone SoCs to AI ASICs.

customers.name: GOOGL
customers.deal: TPU v7 I/O design; TPU v9 collaboration

suppliers.label: Micron
suppliers.disclosed_mix: HBM customer base grew from 4 to 6 in Q3 FY26 (mgmt); HBM4 revenue topped $1B, gross margin >81% for first time; no customer-level % breakout disclosed.

suppliers.label: SK Hynix
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Nvidia = 13.35% of H1 2026 revenue (down from 24% in FY25) as ASIC diversification grows; added a 2nd customer >10% of revenue in H1 2026 (filings).

customers.name: AVGO
customers.deal: HBM4 orders for custom AI ASICs

suppliers.label: Microsoft
suppliers.disclosed_mix: OpenAI's $250B incremental Azure commitment disclosed (Oct 2025 pact); Microsoft doesn't break out any single customer's % of Azure revenue.

suppliers.label: Alphabet/Google
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Google Cloud backlog ~$460B amid AI capacity constraints (reported); Anthropic's $200B/5yr commitment disclosed, not broken out as % of Cloud revenue.

suppliers.label: Amazon
suppliers.disclosed_mix: AWS doesn't break out any AI-lab customer as % of revenue; Anthropic's $100B/10yr commitment and up to 5GW Trainium/Graviton disclosed jointly, Apr 2026.

suppliers.label: Oracle
suppliers.disclosed_mix: OpenAI's $300B/5yr Stargate contract (~4.5GW) disclosed as the dominant driver of Oracle's RPO surge; no single-customer % of revenue disclosed.
